lines: - Sythel: "We're both more dangerous than we look, you and I. Keep your distance."
- Sythel: "Keep your hands where I can see them."
- Sythel: "You don't know me. You have no idea what I am capable of!"
- Sythel: "Beetles, in the earth, biting oh-so-gently. Tunneling. Up through my skin."
- Sythel: "I've seen them. The black-eyed children. Pointing at me."
- Sythel: "The first scholar looked into the Void and he feared it. And his fear took shape. Do you understand? That's how all this started."
- Sythel: "I- I can't stay in here forever. I'll starve, get bitten, catch the swarming rot. Little eggs under my eyelids!"
- Sythel: "Listen! There! Did you hear it? Rap. Tap. Tap."
- Sythel: "Not safe here. They'll find me! Her with her carriage. Always nosing around. Got to move, find a new place!"

During Fear Spirals in Duviri, the Drifter has the opportunity to play through the tale of The Fearful Conspirator, centring on Sythel, as part of the Tales of Duviri. As with the rest of the tales, they are narrated by Euleria Entrati.
- Euleria Entrati: "One haunted day in Duviri, Sythel awoke with a thought: if I could destroy what I fear, I wouldn't have to fear it anymore!"
- Euleria Entrati: "Afraid to go outside and afraid to be shut in, Sythel lived a timorous life. Usually, she was too scared to act… but not always."
- Euleria Entrati: "Sythel looked in horror upon what had been done in her name. Surely there would be consequences!"
- Euleria Entrati: "Like the first rumblings of a landslide, the ominous consequences of Sythel's actions began to build."
- Euleria Entrati: "Another might have taken courage from seeing the things she feared exterminated, but not Sythel."
- Euleria Entrati: "Sythel's fear spiralled. The more she tried to be bold, the greater grew her fear of being found out."
- Euleria Entrati: "Her brutal actions had consequences. Like a deadly pestilence, Sythel's fear spread across Duviri."
- Euleria Entrati: "Sythel left fear in her wake. Doors were closed and windows barred, and voices spoke in whispers."
- Euleria Entrati: "Fear ruled Duviri… and yet Sythel, the embodiment of fear, was more afraid than ever."
- Euleria Entrati: "All Duviri now lived in terror of Sythel. What a long shadow this scrawny little figure had cast!"
- Euleria Entrati: "Sythel was afraid to go on, but she was even more afraid to stop. Her fears were allying against her now."
- Euleria Entrati: "Even as her plans led to disaster after disaster, Sythel was more afraid of what might still come to pass."
- Euleria Entrati: "For an instant, as she shed her pitiful human form, Sythel was no longer afraid, for she had become fear."
- Sythel: "Can I trust you? I have to. They're everywhere, plotting against me. I need you to destroy them. Every single last one."
- Sythel: "They've kept me locked up inside my own mind all these years, frightening me with their tricks. Now I need you to make THEM afraid."
- Sythel: "The Dax know everything. Why did you let them find out our plan? You've got to wipe them out quickly. Come on, let's get cutting throats."
- Sythel: "It's only a matter of time before the Dax find out what we're up to. There's a bunch of them nearby, acting suspicious. You need to get them before they get us."
- Sythel: "I feel sick. The King suspects. I'm sure of it. He's going to send an assassin after me. Any moment now. You have to get to the assassin first."
- Sythel: "I'm scared of mazes. You never know what might be skulking at the center. You go look. I'll wait."
- Sythel: "One day I might be locked up in one of those mazes. Then you'll have to get me out. I need to know you can do that. Show me."
- Sythel: "I don't like this. Broken down machinery is suspicious. It attracts attention. Hurry. Fix it before someone sees."
- Sythel: "I think this generator pumps the air in Duviri. And it's... broken? Oh Void. I can't breathe. My head's spinning. I'm going to die. Fix it!"

path: Defeat the Dax guarding the treasure
lines: - Sythel: "Listen, if I'm ever going to get out of here, set up someplace new, I'm going to need funds. Maybe... maybe you could find some... Dax pay chests? They won't miss them."
- Sythel: "You know what's in those chests the Dax are guarding? Evidence, that's what. I need it, even if you have to go through them to get it."

path: Purge the darkened areas of Liminus
lines: - Sythel: "They're coming out of the ground. The unhallowed earth. Shadows, moving. I can't look at them! Make them go away!"
- Sythel: "My own nightmares are bad enough. I don't want Thrax's crawling inside my head too. Kill them, kill them, kill them!"

path: Stay close to the prisoner to free them
lines: - Sythel: "I ordered a man executed. I was sure he was conspiring against me. But now... I'm... I'm afraid he might be... innocent. You have to stop the Dax. Before it's too late."
- Sythel: "The Dax want to kill one of my prisoners. You mustn't let them. I need him alive for... secret reasons."
- Sythel: "You have to go to the place where bad dreams are real. The Undercroft. Whatever's wrong there, make it right. Hurry!"
- Sythel: "Everyone's afraid of the Undercroft. Even Thrax. It's too close to the Void. To... to HIM. That's why I'm sending you in there."
- Sythel: "I can't go near the Undercroft portals. Can't bear to think about what... might... come out of them. It's going to have to be you."
- Sythel: "Oh no. Oh no no. There's something wrong in the Undercroft. I can't go down there, not after what I saw that time."
- Sythel: "I need protection. Talismans. Incantations. Weapons. Whatever you can find. Search around. There has to be something I can use."
- Sythel: "I locked something up near here, I know I did. Books. Dried roots. A prisoner? Can't be sure. But I need to find it again."

path: Open the chest and defeat its guardian
lines: - Sythel: "I can't bear the sight of those things. Thrax's favored. Like something out of a vapor vision. You're going to have to kill it and take whatever it was put here to guard."
- Sythel: "Oh, Thrax brought monsters to life to defend his kingdom. But you're stronger than Thrax aren't you? You're a monster-killer, treasure-finder, aren't you? Well?"
- Sythel: "There's a broken shrine nearby. That's bad. Leave a shrine broken and things will come after you. Bony hands and snaking tongues and... please, put it back together."
- Sythel: "There's a shrine. And I thought it was cursed. So I broke it. Into bits. And now I think I'm cursed. Just... just put it back together for Void's sake."
- Sythel: "Kaithes terrify me. I keep dreaming I'm at a race and those pounding hooves trample me to pulp. Maybe if you run a race... and that DIDN'T happen... it might be okay."
- Sythel: "That Kaithe might be mad. Void struck. Dangerous. You'd better ride all the crazy out of it. Wear it out... to be safe."
- Sythel: "Don't tell me Tamms are harmless. I've seen the way they look at me. All that CHEWING. Round them up and keep them away from me!"
- Sythel: "The Tamms are plotting something. They're out of their pens. I don't like it. Round them up. Put them back."
- Sythel: "Something's trying to reach you. Through the mirror, the guarded mirror. This is YOUR problem! Deal with it!"
- Sythel: "One of us has to kill those Dax. Look into that mirror. See whatever is waiting there. You, obviously, not me."
- Sythel: "What kind of idiot robs a tomb? I saw them, taking the grave goods into a cave. Fetch them back. Before the dead... get... upset!"
- Sythel: "Pretty trinkets... underground. What if children go down there looking for them? What if something bad... happens... there...? In the dark? Get those trinkets!"
- Sythel: "I'm too scared to give Kullervo what he truly needs so he can rest. The challenge of an equal! Oh but you... you're strong! You can do it."
- Sythel: "The Warden cages Kullervo, pokes at him, stokes his rage. Putting us all in danger. Give Kullervo what he needs. The honor of a fair fight."
- Sythel: "You! You were never on my side to start with, were you? All along you've been plotting with them... siding with them... preparing to betray ME! IT'S TIME FOR YOU TO BE AFRAID!!"
- Sythel: "Who ARE you? Who are you really? Why do I hear whispers in my head when I look at you?! WHY ARE YOUR EYES LIKE THAT?!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "I know what you're planning!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "You don't have to do this."
- Orowyrm Sythel: "Ah! It's crawling on me!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "No! Please! Don't hurt me."
- Orowyrm Sythel: "I... I don't want this!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "Eurgh, its fingers are like slugs!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "Oh Void! Oh no! Oh no nononono!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "Get them away from me!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "There's no way out of here."
- Orowyrm Sythel: "What happened to my legs? What happened to me?"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "I'm going to be trapped in this ugly form forever and ever!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "I'll drag you down with me, don't think I won't!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "You'll be in here with ME for eternity! Is that what you want?!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "Disgusting little mannequins all over me! AAAAAH!"
- Orowyrm Sythel: "I'm so scared. I'm so scared. I'M SO SCARED!!"
- Sythel: "The king can't find out what we're doing here. Oh Void, what if he already suspects? We'll have to make it look like a simple robbery. You don't mind stealing, do you?"
- Sythel: "I'm going to need somewhere to run to. In case this all goes wrong; a place to hide. Yes. I know just the place. But they're already there. One step ahead of us. Keep it safe for me?"
- Sythel: "It makes your flesh creep walking up to those towers, knowing the Dax could pick you off any time he wanted. I can't stand it. You have to clear them out!"
- Sythel: "Ugh... watchful eyes always looking down at you, making your skin crawl. Get rid of those sentries."
- Sythel: "Thrax could have me executed with a snap of his fingers. I need something I can use against him. Whatever these Dax are guarding has to be important."
- Sythel: "Too many people... with grudges. Reasons to hate me, wanting me dead. Going to need leverage, funds. Find me some funds, even if you have to murder a few Dax to do it."
- Sythel: "I found this, in one of the crypts. It put a curse on me, I know it! I need you to take it to a safe place, and leave it there!"
- Sythel: "Acrithis lent me these books. She said they came from the scholar himself. Bad things in them, Void things. You need to take them away!"
